sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Track, fill and thumb
sections.what: Draws the track, the filled part and the round grab handle, and gives the slider full width with touch handling turned off.
sections.why: Likely reason: turning off touch handling stops dragging from scrolling the page on phones.
sections.watch_out: Only one thumb is included, so a two-handle range needs an extra thumb.

summary: Provides a draggable slider for picking a number within a range, such as a volume level.
purpose: Lets users choose a value by dragging a handle along a track.
why: Likely reason: it wraps a slider library and applies the app's styling.
how: A track shows the full range in a light tint. A filled part shows the chosen portion. A round thumb can be dragged along the track.
inputs: Range settings and the value from the library, plus style overrides.
outputs: A slider that reports value changes.
risks: Only one thumb is drawn, so a two-handle range needs another thumb added.
debug: If the thumb does not move, check the value and change handler are connected.
